notes: Posted 28 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards: the Objective (posted above the starting section as 'Objective Hunt Down/TFHGOOTU') plus 'Starting(9)': Epic Duel, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage Of The Emperor, Start Your Engines!, Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Sebulba's Podracer and Watto's Box; all count toward the 60. Visage Of The Emperor (deployed with the Objective) is shown as the starting effect; Watto's Box is pulled by Start Your Engines!.

Posted 'Exec. Holotheatre' dested Executor: Holotheatre; 'Exec. Med. Chamber' Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Visage Of The Empy' Visage Of The Emperor; 'Tat. Podrace Arena' and 'Boonta Eve Podrace' the Dark pages; 'Sebulba´s Racer' Sebulba's Podracer.

Posted 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Emperor Palpy' Emperor Palpatine; '4-Lom w/gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Dr.E&PondaB.' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Vader´s Stick' Darth Vader's Lightsaber; 'Maul´s Stick' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Bossk in bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth (and the other '<hunter> in ship' lines the matching combo starships).
Posted 'Masta Move' dested Masterful Move; 'T´wilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Sniper/Dark Strike' the combo Sniper & Dark Strike.
Secret Plans is the 2001 Special Edition Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
Posted 'Endor Back Door' in a Dark deck dested Endor: Back Door (Dark); Endor: Forest Clearing and Endor: Dark Forest are Dark Endor sites.
